messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy, no, she had to try to yank my arm out of the socket chasing the cat.

output.original_text: The other two ran out and did their business, but not Daisy, no, she had to try to yank my arm out of the socket chasing the cat.
output.joy: The other two ran out and did their business, but Daisy, oh Daisy, was so excited that she nearly yanked my arm out of the socket chasing the cat!
output.sadness: The other two ran out and did their business, but Daisy, poor thing, she was so eager to chase the cat she almost yanked my arm out of the socket.
output.fear: The other two ran out and did their business, but Daisy, no, she was so frantic chasing the cat that I thought she might yank my arm out of the socket!
output.anger: The other two ran out and did their business, but Daisy had to be a wild one and nearly yank my arm out of the socket chasing that cat!
output.surprise: The other two ran out and did their business, but can you believe Daisy? She almost yanked my arm out of the socket trying to chase the cat!
output.disgust: The other two ran out and did their business, but Daisy, ugh, she had to yanked my arm out of the socket in her crazy chase after that cat.
